background: Leek Building Society is a small mutual based in Staffordshire, funded by retail savings from its branches across the county and neighbouring areas and lending on residential mortgages.
synthesis: None of the three agencies rates the society, and the site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is nothing to set against its peers here. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. For a depositor the position is simple: a small regional mutual with no public rating and no published ratios on this site, so any placement rests on the society's own accounts and on the deposit guarantee rather than on anything shown here.
